mapper.select: WITH Walk AS ( SELECT l.ToProductId AS ProductId, ',1,' + CAST(l.ToProductId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + ',' AS Path FROM {{schema}}.ShopProductLinks AS l WHERE l.FromProductId = 1 UNION ALL SELECT n.ToProductId, w.Path + CAST(n.ToProductId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + ',' FROM Walk AS w JOIN {{schema}}.ShopProductLinks AS n ON n.FromProductId = w.ProductId WHERE w.Path NOT LIKE '%,' + CAST(n.ToProductId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) + ',%') SELECT DISTINCT w.ProductId AS ProductId FROM Walk AS w OPTION (MAXRECURSION 10)
